build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized left, height, blocks, and base_width
create_dynamic_bar_stack: create a stack of dynamic bars using C.add with scale, angle, and position parameters
create_ball_on_slope: create a dynamic ball placed on a static bar slope with a blocking wall
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by setting body1, body2, and SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING via C.update_task
set_solution_tier_meta: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.PRE_TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta
